findings.claim: The I8 test's check that another drive's view does not refresh can pass without testing anything: it never asserts that the other-drive view fetched its listing before the drop.
findings.impact: Suppose the `<FolderBrowser driveName="other" />` view stops calling `getDriveFiles` with an empty path, for example because its params change shape so `DRIVE_ROOT` no longer matches. Then `before.other` and the after-count are both 0, and the test passes even if a completion on `main` refreshed the other drive's view. A regression of the 'no view of another drive' clause of I8 would get through.
findings.evidence: In frontend/src/__tests__/uploadQueueRefresh.test.tsx, the `before` block asserts `toBeGreaterThan(0)` for recipes, series and search, but not for `before.other`. The final assertion is `expect(listingsFor(api, "other", DRIVE_ROOT)).toBe(before.other)`. The commit under review (b4ccecfc5) does not touch these lines.
findings.repro: Mutation, predicted by reading and not run: change DRIVE_ROOT to `(p) => p.path === "__never__"`, or make the other-drive FolderBrowser fetch with `path: "/"`. Both counts become 0 and the assertion still passes, so the mutant survives.

bucket_proposal.reason: This weakens a test only. The production code filters by drive (`useUploadCompleted` compares `completedDrive === drive`), so I8 holds today.

findings.proposed_fix: Add `expect(before.other).toBeGreaterThan(0);` next to the other `before` assertions.

specification_compliance: Commit b4ccecfc5 adds one line, `vi.clearAllMocks()`, to the top-level beforeEach of frontend/src/__tests__/uploadQueueRefresh.test.tsx (line 74). It changes no production code and no assertion.

The fix is coherent with the failure the commit message describes. `vi.resetModules()` does not reset the mock registry, so the factory-made `vi.fn()`s in `@/lib/api` keep their call history across tests. The I8 test's `expect(api.completeUpload).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` would then count the Clear test's earlier call. `vi.clearAllMocks()` clears call history and keeps implementations. Both tests set the `initUpload` resolution they need themselves. `uploadChunk` and `completeUpload` keep the factory's `mockResolvedValue({})`, which mockClear does not reset.
The listing counts in both tests are deltas measured after render (`before` against after), so they did not depend on the carried-over history. Only the absolute `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` did.

Earlier open items are untouched by this round: r1 F4 (`disarmLeaveConfirmation()` runs before `await lockApi()`), r2 F1 (no test checks that MiniPlayerContainer and MobileInspectorSheet publish to bottomChrome) and r2 F2 (substring-only offset assertions).
potential_unspecified_behavior: Still present from r1 F4: if the lock request fails after the viewer confirms, the leave-page confirmation stays disarmed for the rest of the session (Sidebar.tsx performLock).
regression_risks: Other suites built on the shared `apiMock` (uploadLock.test.tsx, hooks/__tests__/uploadQueue.test.tsx) already call `vi.resetAllMocks()` in beforeEach and reconfigure. A new suite that copies the pre-fix pattern of uploadQueueRefresh.test.tsx (resetModules without clearing mocks) would have the same order-dependent call counts.
No vitest config option (`clearMocks`, `mockReset`, `restoreMocks`) enforces clearing globally, so each file has to clear the mocks itself.
test_coverage: I8: same-drive refresh, other-drive no-refresh and search no-refresh are covered. The other-drive half has no baseline greater than zero (F1).
I12: covered. Clear removes the finished entry and triggers no listing re-fetch for either drive.
The order-dependence fixed here affected only the absolute `completeUpload` count in the I8 test.
not_verified: I did not run the suite in shuffled or sequential order, so I did not confirm that the flake is gone.
I did not check which Vitest version is installed, or whether `mockClear` in that version keeps `mockResolvedValue` implementations. I assumed it does, as documented.
I did not check whether the CI shuffle job sets its seed in a workflow file outside frontend/.
I executed no mutant. Every survived outcome is a prediction from reading the tests.
trajectory: There have been two fix rounds since r1. 89b738ec6 (r2) added a test that renders the real UploadProgress for I13. b4ccecfc5 (r3) adds one `vi.clearAllMocks()` to fix a test-isolation flake. Neither round adds a production branch, state or prediction, and neither removes one. The design is not being patched. Both rounds tighten tests only.
